repo: @cipherbox/crypto (verify/parse/publicKeyFromIpnsName) and @cipherbox/core (createIpnsRecord/marshalIpnsRecord) are already in apps/tee-worker/package.json — no new deps needed for the TEE rewrite
mock-ipns-routing already occupies 127.0.0.1:3001; new local tee-worker service must use 127.0.0.1:3002:3001 + TEE_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:3002 in API env
parseIpnsRecord's record.pubKey is undefined for Ed25519 identity records — never use it for name-to-key binding; use publicKeyFromIpnsName(ipnsName) against the decrypted private key instead

EPOCH_ZERO_TIMESTAMP_MS is undefined in the codebase — TEE cannot do pure clock-based epoch derivation without an anchor; recommended pattern is entry.keyEpoch as ECIES epoch hint + getInternalCurrentEpoch() (clock + env anchor, fallback epoch 1) for the floor guard
BullMQ E2E trigger for republish queue: new Queue('republish', { connection: { host: 'localhost', port: 6380 } }).add('republish-batch', {}) — no dev HTTP endpoint exists or is needed
bullmq is absent from tests/sdk-e2e/package.json; it must be added as a devDep in 67-05 (bullmq + pg both already in apps/api and lockfile so no truly new-to-repo packages)
apps/tee-worker/Dockerfile exists — local compose uses build context, not an image pull
pnpm monorepo worktrees lack node_modules/built dist — worktree-based parallel execution is fragile; sequential on main tree is more reliable for this repo
scripts/check-api-client.sh only trips when .entity.ts/.dto.ts/.controller.ts files change AND openapi.json actually diffs — internal entity changes (no DTO/controller) never require api:generate

Deliberate cross-wave compile break: 67-01 slims the republish-schedule entity while callers in republish.service.ts aren't restored until 67-07 (Wave 2); apps/api is intentionally red between waves 1 and 2
gsd commit helper false-negative: returns {committed: false, reason: commit_failed} even when the commit actually landed; always verify with git log --oneline -1 and never retry blindly

code.finding: The + 1n sequence increment — the root-cause bug that makes the TEE an originator instead of a lease-renewer; must be removed in 67-06
Weak LessThanOrEqual write-back for signed_record; must be replaced with equality CAS (WHERE sequence_number = :loaded AND tombstoned_at IS NULL) to prevent stale-record overwrite races
upsertIpnsRecord provides the TypeORM createQueryBuilder().update().set().where().execute() pattern to follow for the new renewIpnsRecordEol equality CAS
